name: Fortnite-API
tagline: Unofficial Fortnite cosmetics, shop, stats, and news endpoints for bots and tools
description: Community-run Fortnite data API providing cosmetics, item shop, player stats, news, and map data commonly used by Discord bots and third-party trackers. Not affiliated with Epic Games.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header (Bearer) or query param; free keys via dashboard signup

use_cases: look up cosmetic by name or ID
list new cosmetics for a season
